title: Ecosia ditched Mistral for Chinese open weights: what it proves
description: Ecosia ditched Mistral for Chinese open weights: what it proves. Europe's climate search engine dropped France's flagship AI lab, calling its models a year behind, and its CEO says the switch to open-weight models roughly cut costs in half while quality improved. The same GLM family it now pays to serve is a nineteen-gigabyte Ollama download at home. You'll learn what open weights actually are, why a paying European company choosing them ends the hobby myth, and the honest catch about bias and rented servers. Subscribe to Build Local AI for weekly guides to running AI on your own hardware. (Narration is AI-generated.)

narration_full: Ecosia dumped Mistral for Chinese open weights. Costs roughly halved, its CEO says. You've heard open weights are a hobby. They're model files anyone can download and run. Ecosia says quality went up, not down. Its new route is Melious, a German host serving only public weights, chiefly Z.ai's GLM. Mistral's Large four preview ranks eighth; every open model above it is Chinese. Even Mistral hosts GLM. That family is downloadable tonight: GLM four point seven Flash on Ollama, a nineteen-gigabyte download. The grain of truth: Ecosia still rents servers, and open weights don't scrub bias. The hobby excuse is dead.

notes_for_review: Check these soft spots before render. (1) 'Costs roughly halved' is CEO Christian Kroll's claim per POLITICO, attributed in-scene ('its CEO says', 'Ecosia says'); we measured nothing. (2) 'Fifteen million users' is Ecosia's own 2021 figure, the freshest first-party number in the brief; it is dated. (3) The ranking line ('eighth, every model above Chinese') comes from Trending Topics at medium confidence; the digits-only rule is satisfied with '8th' on screen and 'eighth' spoken. (4) Timing hedge: Melious is called 'its new route', not current production, because Kroll said 'we'll probably be using Melious in future' while POLITICO ties the cost cut to the move, and Ecosia's help center still lists Mistral small models. (5) GLM four point seven Flash is the small sibling (19GB q4_K_M on Ollama), not the model Ecosia buys; the model name is spelled out in narration to keep narration digit-free, digits appear only on screen. (6) The single wry beat is 'Even Mistral hosts GLM' (claim 10), landing on Mistral, not the viewer. (7) The cookbook analogy was deliberately omitted to stay inside the word band; the catch compresses 'when the myth is still right' into the rented-servers grain of truth.
